title: Lesson 5: Tokens, Context Windows, and Cost Engineering for Agent Workloads
description: Agents don't just use tokens; they burn them: roughly 4x a chat conversation, 15x for multi-agent. The four levers that control the bill (budgeting, compression, caching, and model routing), with the math worked out on a real 10-agent pipeline.
